node.statement: Write the two universal big-O bounds supplied by node 1.7 as U*(delta_n+epsilon_X) for the upper estimate and L*(delta_n+epsilon_X) for the lower estimate, with fixed finite universal U,L independent of n and of the input algebra (enlarging either coefficient if necessary on the common smallness range). Since delta_n=4d<=4*C_np*epsilon_X, choose K=max{4*C_np,U*(4*C_np+1),L*(4*C_np+1)}. Then for every n and x one has the multiplicative defect at most 4d||x||||y||<=K*epsilon_X||x||||y||, and (1-K*epsilon_X)||x||<=||v_n(x)||<=||v_n||*||x||<=(1+K*epsilon_X)||x||. This is one K for all n. This bridge is conditional on, and may be accepted only after, validation of node 1.7.
